verses.1: Unto the end. With hymns, a Canticle Psalm of David.
verses.2: May God have mercy on us and bless us. May he shine his countenance upon us, and may he have mercy on us.
verses.3: So may we know your way upon the earth, your salvation among all nations.
verses.4: Let the peoples confess to you, O God. Let all the peoples confess to you.
verses.5: May the nations rejoice and exult. For you judge the peoples with equity, and you direct the nations on earth.
verses.6: Let the peoples confess to you, O God. Let all the peoples confess to you.
verses.7: The earth has provided her fruit. May God, our God, bless us.
verses.8: May God bless us, and may all the ends of the earth fear him. [ Psalm 67 ] (68)
